notes.title: An Update On The Future Of Snoring Dog Games & 35% Discount Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everybody. It's now been roughly six weeks since The Flayed Man changed from free to a paid model and I wanted to share an update with you all on the impact this has had and the future of Snoring Dog Games.



Before I do, I'd like to bring to your attention that The Flayed Man is now 35% off as part of the Steam Sale, including the Give Me Your Skin Bundle. If you haven't already grabbed a copy or would like to gift a copy to a friend, make sure to do so now!



As per my last message, sales of The Supporter Pack were low and so the move to a paid model was an attempt to raise the funds to make another game. I'm very pleased to say we are now 75% of the way there, and it looks very likely another game will be coming your way. 



We had previously shared some of the games we would like to make. However, we're still nowhere near the level of funds we'd need to make these a reality at this point. Instead, our next will be a visual novel horror roughly 90 minutes to 120 minutes long. The plan is for this to feature the same art style many of you loved along some really weird, unique imagery and thematic points you probably wouldn't have seen in other games. It's much more along the lines of Slay The Princess, Milk Inside A Bag of Milk and other such games than a traditional VN. 



I'm going to put everything I have into the story and the game, and we will be aiming for a 2026 release for this. I'll still be paying the accountant out of my own pocket, so all funds raised from The Flayed Man will be going into paying the artists for the game. 



When I say we're at 75%, this is for what I would consider the bare minimum we need to bring the game to life. We can probably still make the game with current funds but we are reliant on your continued support to bring our full vision to life. If we can exceed the 25%, that will allow us to expand and make the game even better.



That's why I'm asking you to help make this a reality. Things you can do:



Buy a copy of the game or Give Me Your Skin Bundle for yourself or a gift to friends.

Share the game on social media or tell your friends and family about it.

Leave a review on the Steam page if you enjoyed it.



Any of these actions will be a great help and much appreciated. I'm hoping our next message will be to confirm we reach our target.



Special Thanks To Our Turkish Fans



Inexplicably our game caught on in Türkiye, and roughly 70% of all sales has been from you. I want to give you all a special Teşekkürler for helping to ensure we will be able to make another game. I would love to have The Flayed Man and our next game translated, but again this relies on funds. If you'd like to make this a reality, then please help us by doing any of the actions above so we can do so.



Lastly, I would also like to offer all of my future games on a special once a year heavy discount on a special day in Türkiye. Republic Day falls into Halloween sales, so if you're a Turkish fan, please let me know a different special day in Türkiye that would be best.



I'm also very grateful to all our fans worldwide who make up the other 30%, you've really helped us and we hope to repay you with another great game.



Our next update will be after the Summer Sale, I hope we will be able to share some positive news and a teaser for our next game then.

notes.title: The Flayed Man Is On Sale & Has Been Updated
notes.content:
Hi everybody. Following on from our last post The Flayed Man has now changed from a free to a paid model. You can read the reasons why here and I want to emphasise this is a Hail Mary to raise the funds to make our next game. We have tailored pricing internationally, meaning that it is equally affordable around the globe. I would especially like to thank all of the people who bought a version on the Supporter Pack back when the base game was free, your generosity is tremendous.

For those of you who missed the opportunity to grab a copy for free, I'm very pleased to share that The Flayed Man and the Supporter Pack are now on sale until Monday 26th May. You can also buy the Give Me Your Skin bundle containing both and discounted by 15% for as long as we're on Steam.

We have added several updates to both the base game and the Supporter Pack which I'm pleased to share with you below:

The Flayed Man Base Game

 We have added three more achievements to the game, bringing the total number to 18.
 Recognising that players unfamiliar with Point & Clicks have been confused by the mechanics, there is now a basics page that goes over how to play the game.
 Wondering why there's a photo of a dog at the end of the game? Well the ask to buy a Supporter Pack is gone and replaced by an explanation.

The Flayed Man Supporter Pack

 The Supporter Pack now comes with a CC BY-NC 4.0 license, meaning as long as it's non-commercial and you attribute us, you can use everything within the Supporter Pack however you like.
 In the spirit of the CC licence, I have now also added .MIDI files of all the tracks in the game, so you can edit & remix to your heart's content.
 There have been six avatars added for use on Steam or other forums. Freak out your friends and family by making them ask why you have a skinless man being torn apart as your avatar.
 We have added all four of the backgrounds, you can use them as wallpapers or any other purpose you like in line with the licence.

If you already have a copy of the Supporter Pack, all of the new extras should be added. Please message me directly or leave a post Community Hub thread if you don't have access to them.

I'd like to thank everybody who has played the game for their support, we hope this final push over the next few months might be enough to help us keep the lights on at Snoring Dog Games to make more games for you in the future.

notes.title: The Flayed Man is finished and our Discord launches next week.
notes.content:
I'm really happy to say that the Flayed Man is now fully completed with 15 Steam Achievements integrated and working. You may already have seen it, but in case you haven't, the Supporter Pack Steam Page is also live on Steam and can be found here. If you enjoy the game when it comes out, please consider purchasing, we've gone through every country individually and priced it to equal a pint of beer (and cheaper in some places). 

In terms of what's happening in March:


 Discord launches next Wednesday:  Every Thursday will be Inspiration Thursday where I'll share some of the games, movies, books, and other media that inspired The Flayed Man. It'll also be a general place for chit-chat for people who like games about skinless men.

 Review copies will go out to reviewers: I've been very lucky to have quite a few places online agree to review, but if there's a site/stream you like (or you run one), let us know and we can sort getting a copy over to you/them.

 New Trailers:  A new short teaser trailer will be coming out sometime in March (probably mid-month) ahead of a second release trailer in April, so keep an eye out to see more of the game.

Thanks to everybody who has supported us so far, we can't wait to share the game with you all on April 17th.

notes.title: Looking Forward Into February
notes.content:
So it's now been nine days since The Flayed Man was announced. I have to say, it's been a surprise for a no-name Indie releasing their first public game for free at the level of interest the game has received. I have a secret number of players I hope play the game (okay, if you can keep the secret, it's 100) and with wishlists we've far exceeded that number already. It's also been surreal to see the game on sites like Bloody Disgusting, Dread Central, Adventure Game Hotspot and more.  So I just want to thank everybody who's wishlisted the game, shared it, and joined this community. 

Now onto the update. What I would consider the "base" game is finished. There's an optional hint system that's been implemented (surprisingly easy) and the sound has been fixed and levelled correctly (surprisingly hard). Moving into February there's certain things that I will be working on:


 Implementing Steam Achievements - There'll be a few of these and they are my main priority. To get them all, you'll have to replay the game a few times, and there's a couple that will reward those who approach things oddly.

 Scoping out Linux version - So I don't actually have a Linux system, but for the three folks out there (actual number) who have wishlisted it for Linux, I will try my best to make it a reality, even if might take slightly longer than the Windows release.

 Setting up Discord - So I'll be setting up a discord to chat about the game, share some of influences from across the media that inspired both The Flayed Man and our gamedev journey generally, as well as a place for general chit-chat.

Our next announcement should be in the next week or two with the link to the discord, but until then, you can keep in touch via Bluesky or sign up to our mailing list for monthly updates.

Until then, have a great weekend everybody!

notes.title: Wishlist The Flayed Man Now!
notes.content:
Hello!

Welcome to the official Steam page for The Flayed Man, an upcoming free point and click horror game. I've been working on this game for roughly 14 months now, partnering up with some fantastic artists to produce a horror game that scratches that age old question what if Silent Hill met Broken Sword?

Come rain or shine, the game will be released on 17th April 2024.

Although the game will be completely free, there will be the opportunity buy a supporters pack to help fund our next game, more details on that will come later.

In terms of where we're at now: 


Story: 100%
Graphics: 100%
Sound: 90%
Programming: 90% This is primarily for steam integration for achievements.

We look forward to sharing the game with you soon but if you haven't already wishlist now. If you'd like to receive exclusive monthly content, insights, and updates on our games then please sign up to the Snoring Dog Games Mailing List.
